title: Avoid Unnecessary Allocations
goal: Choose the solution that parses strings without allocating heap memory.
hints: Parsing can run directly on a string slice without copying it.
Propagating with `?` unwraps the success value, which must then be wrapped in `Ok(...)`.
explanation: The idiomatic Rust approach parses directly from the `&str` slice using `?` to early-return errors and wraps the unpacked port in `Ok(...)`. Returning a raw integer directly causes a type mismatch with `Result`, while calling `.unwrap()` panics on invalid input instead of propagating errors.
